title: 24 Hours of
Barbershop
title.tagline: Arrange all night. Rehearse all day. Go on stage.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.copy: On Friday evening in Berlin, arrangers draw a song and a quartet from a hat. The clock starts. By 8pm the next day, that music will be performed live — written, rehearsed, and staged in under 24 hours.

arrangers.title: Arrangers
copy: You draw a song and a quartet at random on Friday evening. Spend an hour getting to know their voices, then head off to write. A dedicated arranging space — tables, side rooms, good coffee — is yours for the night.
Lead sheets in MuseScore + MusicXML prepared for every song. Write in whatever software you like. We print and deliver by 8am.
Strong recommendation: finish a complete, singable arrangement first, then add embellishments. Remember, the singers have 12 hours to put this together.

singers.title: Singers
copy: Register as a complete quartet, or come solo — we'll form you into quartets on Friday evening. We'll have treble, mixed, and bass ranges. You meet your arranger, share your range and vibe, then the night is yours.
At 8am Saturday, your arrangement arrives. One intense, structured day of rehearsal — individual prep, section work, ensemble runs, arranger coaching in the afternoon.
Focus on the harmony, not memorisation. Sheet music is allowed on stage.

gathering.title: Gathering
copy: Meet, mingle, form quartets for individual singers

drawing.title: The Drawing
copy: Arrangers pull a song and a quartet from a hat
Tagging sessions begin

begin.title: The Night Begins
copy: Arrangers: pizza, coffee, a blank page
Singers: dinner and tag scavenger hunt — details TBA

tag_stop.title: Tagging Stop
copy: Rehearsal starts in 8 hours, please sleep

pancake_break.title: Pancake Break
copy: Mandatory break, then back to work
Optional feedback with your fellow arrangers

done.title: Pencils Down
copy: PDFs, notes, learning tracks delivered
Singers: Rehearsal rooms open. Good luck and swift learning!
Arrangers: sleep

prep.title: Individual Prep
copy: Listen, mark difficult spots, warm up voices

sectionals.title: Section Rehearsals
copy: Learn notes by voice parts

ensemble.title: Ensemble Rehearsal
copy: Crash-through arrangements, find points of coordination between parts, tune chords

interpretation.title: Musical Interpretation
copy: Dynamics, phrasing, story, performance

pippin.title: Arranger Joins Rehearsal
copy: Coach the arrangement, fix issues, run it

concert.title: concert
copy: The curtain goes up. Everything written, learned, and performed inside 24 hours.

register.open: Open to barbershop arrangers and singers of all experience levels. Come as a complete quartet, as a solo singer, or as an arranger ready for the most intense night of your writing life.

fee.per: per person — covering Friday dinner, venue, and materials.
